integrity: The proof was reconstructed from coefficient extraction, Frobenius in a truncated power-series ring, and a logarithmic-derivative root-sum identity. Exact finite checks are sanity tests only. Literature searches cannot prove absolute novelty, and no independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The result is modulo \(p\) only. It does not provide a uniform modulo-\(p^2\) lift or an exceptional \(q\)-analogue, and it does not claim novelty for the Domb specialization \(l=4\), \(m=2\), \(p=5\), which is already contained in the source paper’s stronger Domb theorem.
title: The exceptional branch in Sun’s multinomial prime congruence
